finding.summary: The exact probe body ignored failure to allocate the helper workqueue and still bound the device.
stock_evidence: offline_static/ghidra_stock/decompiled/0156_00112038_syna_dev_probe.c stores alloc_workqueue("synaptics_tcm_helper") at tcm+1352 (0x548), initializes the helper work item, and returns success without checking the allocation result.
syna_dev_process_unexpected_reset only admits reset work while the helper queue slot is non-NULL, so the bound device would silently lose unexpected-reset recovery.
finding.impact: Degraded device operation after memory pressure: touch probing succeeds, but the asynchronous reset-recovery callback cannot run.

change.mechanism: The exact 1408-byte stock body remains under syna_dev_probe_stock_exact. A public wrapper checks the queue at tcm+0x548 after successful probe.
change.allocation_failure: Call syna_dev_remove to quiesce the cdev, stop/drain work, unregister input_agent, disconnect the IRQ/input path, release TCM resources, clear platform drvdata, and return -ENOMEM.
change.normal_path: When the helper queue exists, return the exact probe result without additional teardown or API changes.
change.classification: HARDENED_STOCK_DEVIATION; the active symbol is a rollback wrapper around the preserved stock body.

limits: No kernel runtime, allocation fault injection, Android boot, or NX809J hardware execution was performed.
Rollback on helper-workqueue allocation failure is supported by static path review and canonical compilation, not dynamic fault injection.
